name: Move Sonny's Car Wash to Amazon Redshift
steps:
1.  From the Data Sources section select **Sonny's Car Wash** as the data source.
2.  Select your added **Amazon Redshift** data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Add Access Key and Store Hash to add Credentials.
4.  Click on [+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/sonny-car-wash/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
